definitions.gloss: ill will; bad feeling; animosity; hostility
definitions.explanation: Negative feelings toward someone, such as resentment, hostility, or dislike. Describes a persistent emotional attitude rather than a temporary mood.

examples.japanese: {悪感情|あくかんじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧{悪感情|あくかんじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I have no ill feelings toward him.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{悪感情|あくかんじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: That remark caused bad feelings between the two of them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悪感情|あくかんじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えて→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧、ようやく⟦{和解|わかい}する→和解する：14912_wakaisuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: They were finally able to reconcile after overcoming years of animosity.

notes:
Composed of {悪|あく} (bad, evil) and ⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧ (feeling, emotion). A straightforward compound describing negative interpersonal feelings. Often appears in formal or written contexts when discussing relationships or conflicts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪感情|あくかんじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧: to harbor ill will
- {悪感情|あくかんじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧: for bad feelings to arise
- {悪感情|あくかんじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have no ill will
- {悪感情|あくかんじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have bad feelings

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{敵意|てきい}→敵意：16853_tekii⟧: hostility, enmity — stronger; implies active opposition or antagonism
- ⟦{反感|はんかん}→反感：08675_hankan⟧: antipathy, aversion — focuses on instinctive dislike or opposition
- ⟦{悪意|あくい}→悪意：19922_akui⟧: malice, ill intent — implies deliberate intention to harm, not just negative feelings
